R1 discusses judgment about delay assumptions and generically mentions prior investments, but does not specify their nature or a particular bid, capital commitment, contractual exposure or resource-allocation decision. The supplied evidence supports forecasting and pipeline reporting rather than a substantive risk-bearing choice.

literal_output.assembly: Exact literal JSONL row strings joined with comma-newline and wrapped in the labels object; no substantive row changes.
literal_output.mechanical_checks: Passed topic order, required fields, keyword membership, checked passage IDs/order, exact quotation membership, status/confidence values and action consistency.

settings.basis: assignment metadata and released own reader metadata

source_limits: Exact retained masked/processed component text; not an unmodified or complete call.
All exact-text candidate matches are retained; duplicate text does not identify one speaker.
Delivered CEO-subset membership/flag is attribution, not independently verified role or tenure.
No match in the delivered CEO subset does not independently establish a non-CEO role.
Three saved representatives illustrate each topic; they do not exhaust membership or establish risk preference.
Historical unkeyed density provenance remains separate; no density-based resampling is used.
